To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the color reflection symmetry (C-symmetry) is spontaneously broken in QCD, and this symmetry breaking is responsible for the color confinement.

the QCD vacuum is a color superconductor with the monopole pairing, that the color reflection in the QCD effective action is the origin of the confinement, that this is a generalization of the GSO-projections of the supersymmetry in NSR string, and that the Abelian dominance is not the origin of the color confinement.
the QCD effective action is free of infra-red divergence, that the monopole is the dominant force in QCD, and that the confinement is the consequence of the monopoles condensation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the dimensional transmutation in gauge theories, which is a fundamental problem in the quantum field theory.
the dimensional transmutation by monopole condensations in QCD.
the dimensional transmutation in QCD and the monopole mechanism of the confinement.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the monopole confinement is the correct scenario of QCD, and the Abelian projection is only an effective description of it.
the color confinement in the QCD is the dimensional transmutation by the monopole-condensation.
the monopole confinement is the only mechanism for color confinement in QED and in QCD, and it is the monpole dominance which is responsible for this confinement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the color confinement in Yang-Mills theories is the dimensional transmutation by the monopole-antimonopole condensation, which can be seen as a generalization of the BCS theory.
the SNO effective action is gauge variant and the SNO instability is an artifact of gauge variant calculation.
the monopole confinement is the only viable mechanism of the confinement in QCD.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the monopole is the most fundamental entity in QCD.
the color reflection symmetry (C-symmetry) is the key ingredient for understanding the color confinement in terms of monopole condensate.
the SNO effective action is not a gauge invariant integral expression and hence is not the one-loop QED effective action.
